name: Stir-fry noodles
instructions:

3. Heat 1 tbsp sunflower oil in a wok over high heat until shimmering. Add the sliced garlic and chilli flakes and stir for 15-20 seconds until fragrant.
4. Add the julienned carrot, chopped beans and cabbage, and the capsicum strips. Stir-fry 4-5 minutes on high heat - they should stay crisp-tender with a little char.

6. Pour in the soy sauce around the edge of the hot wok so it caramelises, sprinkle in the MSG and toss everything hard for 1-2 minutes until evenly coated and glossy.

ingredients: [{"name": "sunflower oil", "quantity": 27.6, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "onion", "quantity": 200.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "tomato", "quantity": 250.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "ginger paste", "quantity": 10.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "garlic paste", "quantity": 10.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "green chillies", "quantity": 6.0, "serving_unit": "nos"}, {"name": "roasted gram", "quantity": 20.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "peanuts", "quantity": 15.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "coconut", "quantity": 50.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "cardamom", "quantity": 2.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "cloves", "quantity": 2.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "cinnamon", "quantity": 2.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "star anise", "quantity": 1.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "fennel seeds", "quantity": 3.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "kalpasi", "quantity": 2.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "turmeric powder", "quantity": 3.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "chilli powder", "quantity": 6.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "jeera powder", "quantity": 3.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "corriander powder", "quantity": 5.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "mutton masala", "quantity": 5.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "garam masala", "quantity": 3.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "corriander leaves", "quantity": 15.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "mint leaves", "quantity": 20.0, "serving_unit": "g"}]
instructions:
* Prepare the Paste:

   * Combine roasted gram (pottukadalai), peanuts, coconut, cardamom, star anise, a small piece of cinnamon, kalpasi, two cloves, and a little fennel seeds in a blender.

   * Grind these ingredients into a smooth paste.

 * Sauté Aromatics:

   * Heat 150 ml of oil in a large pot.

   * Add two bay leaves, two cloves, two small pieces of cinnamon, a small amount of kalpasi, a small piece of star anise, and four cloves to the hot oil.

   * Add 200 grams of sliced onions and sauté until golden brown.

   * Add one spoon of garlic paste and one spoon of ginger paste, then mix well.

   * Add six green chilies and continue to sauté.

 * Add Spices and Tomatoes:

   * Add half a spoon of turmeric powder, two spoons of chili powder, two spoons of cumin powder, one spoon of coriander powder, two spoons of mutton masala, and one spoon of garam masala.

   * Mix the spices thoroughly with the sautéed ingredients.

   * Add five chopped tomatoes and mix until they soften.

   * Add a little water and salt to taste.

   * Add a small bunch of coriander leaves and a slightly larger amount of mint leaves.

   * Continue to cook until the tomatoes are well mashed and the oil separates.

 * Incorporate the Ground Paste and Finish:

   * Add the previously ground paste to the pot and mix it in.

   * Pour in about 3 liters of water.

   * Check the salt level and adjust if needed.

   * Cover the pot and let it boil for about 10 minutes.

   * Once cooked, garnish with coriander leaves.

name: Briyani
ingredients: [{"name": "chicken", "quantity": 400.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "rice", "quantity": 250.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "greek yogurt", "quantity": 120.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "ginger garlic paste", "quantity": 20.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "fried onions", "quantity": 40.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "mint leaves", "quantity": 15.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "fresh coriander", "quantity": 15.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "green chillies", "quantity": 2.0, "serving_unit": "nos"}, {"name": "chilli powder", "quantity": 4.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "turmeric powder", "quantity": 1.5, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "garam masala", "quantity": 4.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "lemon juice", "quantity": 15.0, "serving_unit": "ml"}, {"name": "salt", "quantity": 5.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "bay leaves", "quantity": 2.0, "serving_unit": "nos"}, {"name": "cinnamon", "quantity": 3.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "cloves", "quantity": 1.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "cardamom", "quantity": 2.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "black cardamom", "quantity": 1.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "star anise", "quantity": 1.5, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "shah jeera", "quantity": 2.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "ghee", "quantity": 20.0, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "milk", "quantity": 30.0, "serving_unit": "ml"}, {"name": "saffron", "quantity": 0.25, "serving_unit": "g"}, {"name": "kewra water", "quantity": 2.5, "serving_unit": "ml"}, {"name": "water", "quantity": 3.0, "serving_unit": "cup"}]
instructions:
Kacchi (raw) dum style Hyderabadi biryani.

MARINADE (2h minimum, overnight is best): Whisk yogurt, ginger garlic paste, chilli powder, turmeric, garam masala, lemon juice and salt. Coat the chicken, mix in half the fried onions, half the mint and coriander, and the slit green chillies. Rest 2 hours minimum.

PREP: Soak the saffron in warm milk. Wash and soak the basmati rice for 30 minutes, then drain.

RICE: Boil 3 cups water with bay leaves, cinnamon, cloves, green cardamom, black cardamom, star anise, shah jeera and salt. Add the rice and cook to 70-80% done - the grain should still have a firm bite. Drain immediately (mushy rice is the #1 biryani mistake).

LAYER: In a heavy-bottomed pot, spread the marinated chicken (with its marinade) on the base. Layer the parboiled rice over it. Top with the remaining fried onions, mint, coriander, the saffron milk, kewra water and dots of ghee.

DUM: Seal the pot with foil or a tight lid (traditionally a wheat-dough seal). Place on a hot tawa/griddle over medium heat for 5-10 minutes until steam builds, then cook on the lowest heat for 25-30 minutes. Do not open the lid. Rest sealed for 15 minutes.

SERVE: Open at the table, fluff gently so each plate gets both the chicken layer and the white/saffron-streaked rice. Serve with raita or mirchi ka salan.

name: Salmon Pasta
instructions:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water (8 cups, 4g salt) to the boil and cook the pasta until al dente, 9-10 minutes. Reserve a cup of pasta water before draining.
2. Pat the salmon fillets dry, season with a pinch of the salt, and sear in 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat, skin-side down 3-4 minutes until crisp, then flip and cook 2 minutes more. Break into large flakes on a plate; discard the skin.
3. In the same pan, lower heat to medium and add the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil. Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook 4-5 minutes until they soften and burst into a rough sauce.
4. Add the sliced garlic and chilli flakes and cook 1-2 minutes until fragrant - do not let the garlic brown.
5. Add the drained pasta to the pan with a splash of pasta water and toss so the tomatoes coat every strand, loosening with more pasta water as needed.
6. Fold in the salmon flakes gently (they just need warming through, not re-cooked) and the chopped parsley. Taste for salt and serve immediately.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio Pepperoncino
instructions:
Classic Roman spaghetti aglio, olio e pepperoncino - golden garlic, pasta-water finish, parmesan.

1. Bring generously salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente (about 1 minute short of the packet time). Before draining, scoop out a cup of the starchy pasta water.

2. While the pasta cooks, warm the olive oil in a large pan over LOW heat. Add the thinly sliced garlic and let it steep slowly, shaking the pan, until evenly golden - about 3-4 minutes. Watch closely: pale gold, never brown (burnt garlic turns the whole dish bitter). Add the chilli flakes in the last 30 seconds to bloom in the warm oil, then take the pan off the heat.

3. Drain the pasta and add it straight into the oil OFF the heat. Add a good splash of pasta water and toss vigorously - the starch emulsifies with the oil into a silky sauce that clings to every strand. Add more water a splash at a time if it looks dry.

4. Toss in the chopped parsley, taste and adjust salt. Plate and finish with grated parmesan over each bowl. Serve immediately - this dish waits for no one.

name: Oven-baked Garlic Chilli Spread
instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 180C. Slice the tops off the 2 garlic heads so the cloves are exposed, place them on foil, drizzle with a little of the olive oil and sprinkle a pinch of the salt, then wrap the foil closed.
2. Bake 40 minutes until the cloves are completely soft and golden at the edges. Cool slightly.
3. Squeeze the soft roasted cloves out of their skins into a bowl and mash to a paste.
4. Stir the mash into the remaining olive oil (about 1 cup total across the batch), add the chilli flakes and the rest of the salt (1 tsp), and whisk until smooth.
5. Spoon into a clean jar, making sure the garlic sits under the oil. Keeps 2 weeks refrigerated; bring to room temperature before using - the oil solidifies when cold.
